meta.name: An Unfashionable Tragedy
meta.description: John Pilger travels to Bangladesh to report on the horrors of the famine in the country, its causes and tragedies, circa 1975. With people passing away on the street on a daily basis from starvation and US foreign policy continually ignored,An Unfashionable Tragedydocuments the plight that continues to this day, showing that food is a powerful weapon, more powerful than oil…
